text:
jamie_support: Customer reported credits disappeared after applying a second promo. They say they applied NEW_TRIAL via the portal, then called the API to apply SUMMER2026 ~2 minutes later and their available trial credits dropped from 10 -> 0. Ticket: https://redwood.ai/support/ticket/12345. Need a quick revert and root cause.

promo-bot: Promo service event: applied code NEW_TRIAL -> acct:acct_89a, promo_id:promo_001, credits:+10, event_ts:1747654200

jamie_support: Then this API call (customer supplied) happened: 
```
POST /v1/promos/apply
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Content-Type: application/json
{ "account_id": "acct_89a", "code": "SUMMER2026" }
```
Response was 200 and body: 
```
{ "applied_promo": "SUMMER2026", "credits_added": 0, "total_credits": 0 }
```
Customer says they never lost the portal credit until after this call. :confused:

alex_engineering: Can you paste the server-side logs / webhook events for both operations and any DB ledger entries? Also did they include an Idempotency-Key header on the second request?

jamie_support: Paste of relevant ledger/events: 
```
ledger: acct_89a: CREDIT +10 (promo_001 NEW_TRIAL) tx:tx_9876 ts:1747654201
ledger: acct_89a: PROMO_REMOVE -10 (promo_001) tx:tx_9922 ts:1747655323
ledger: acct_89a: CREDIT +0 (promo_017 SUMMER2026) tx:tx_9923 ts:1747655324
```
Also webhook events from promo service: 
```
promo-webhook: apply: {account:acct_89a, promo:NEW_TRIAL, id:promo_001, ts:1747654200}
promo-webhook: apply: {account:acct_89a, promo:SUMMER2026, id:promo_017, ts:1747655322}
```
No Idempotency-Key present on the API request (customer client omitted it).

sara_billing: Verified balance snapshot: 1747654199 -> available_credits:0, after NEW_TRIAL -> available_credits:10, after SUMMER2026 -> available_credits:0. Billing ledger shows a PROMO_REMOVE entry that corresponds to promo_001 being removed; removal was triggered by the apply flow, not by an explicit remove action.

alex_engineering: Initial hypothesis: the public /v1/promos/apply endpoint currently implements a SET semantics under the hood (account->promo mapping is unique), so applying a new promo replaces the existing mapping. In addition, our transaction path tries to enforce uniqueness by deleting any existing mapping before insert; under concurrent/retry scenarios (no Idempotency-Key) a retry may surface as a separate apply that causes the previous promo to be removed in a separate transaction, leaving the new promo with 0 credit if overlap logic kicks in. This looks like a last-write-wins replacement rather than stacking.

alex_engineering: Repro steps I will run: (1) create acct_89a in staging (2) apply NEW_TRIAL via portal call (3) concurrently POST /v1/promos/apply twice with SUMMER2026, one with Idempotency-Key and one without, and watch ledger tx ordering and any PROMO_REMOVE entries. I'll attach logs.

priya_cs: Customer wants a fast fix. Can we grant a temporary reversal or manual credit while engineering investigates? They are blocked from finishing onboarding.

sara_billing: I'll issue a manual +10 one-time credit and log a reversal ticket against the promo service so finance can reconcile. Actioned, refund_tx:refund_5543. Noting ticket. :white_check_mark:

alex_engineering: Short-term mitigation: update the public docs to clearly state /v1/promos/apply performs a replace (SET) not stack. Long-term: implement an additive path (/v1/promos/stack or change semantics with a query param) and enforce Idempotency-Key at the gateway (400 if missing for mutate endpoints) to avoid duplicate race retries. I'll open an internal PR for the change and a rollback script for affected accounts.

jamie_support: Action items summarized: (1) @alex_engineering reproduce and PR patch + revert script (2) @sara_billing applied manual +10 refund (refund_5543) (3) @priya_cs message customer with temporary credit and ETA (~4h) and link to ticket https://redwood.ai/support/ticket/12345. I'll follow up once engineering posts logs. :+1:

alex_engineering: Repro done in staging, confirmed: concurrent apply without idempotency produced PROMO_REMOVE and left SUMMER2026 with 0 credits because overlap policy favored the previously-applied amount being negated. Created issue INF-3221 and PR draft.

jamie_support: Notified customer, they confirmed credits returned and onboarding continues. Closing interim escalation, leaving INF-3221 for tracking. Thanks team. :pray:
